newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil rebounds at close ahead of PORLA.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil rebounds at close ahead of PORLA.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jly (3rd pos) 1,257 rgt/tonne May (south) 1,335
Open/Hi/Low 1,249/1,258/1,245 Prev close 1,330
Prev settlement 1,245 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market reversed overnight weak trend, with prices closing up on speculation of supportive data from PORLA on Thursday and good May 1-15 export. Ivan"s friendly data and technical buying aided prices. Trading was volatile and July futures rose above 1,250 rgt. Next support is 1,235 and resistance is 1,265.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL- Prices were higher in selective interest.
In his report today, Wong said April's output was expected to rise by 6.6 percent to 728,000 tonnes, end-April stocks at 695,000 tonnes and exports in April at 610,000 tonnes.
"If PORLA confirms Ivan's friendly data today, there may be more buying and shortcovering seen tomorrow," a trader said.
Traders said the market is optimistic that prices will rise further if there are rallies in the soyoil futures tonight.

"The palm market was weak yesterday due to soyoil collapse but some bargain hunting and covering emerged at lower levels today," a trader said, adding that the rebound was just a technical correction.
"Yesterday, third month futures fell below the 1,250 ringgit but some covering emerged and helped it to rise to a high of 1,258 ringgit today," a trader said.
At the close, the July futures contract was 12 ringgit higher at 1,257 ringgit ($498.02) a tonne.
A technical analyst said it will test the resistance of 1,265 ringgit on Thursday, with support pegged at 1,235.
The fimrness in the spot month May futures contract was spilled-over to other contract months.
Physicals also followed the futures market, which found dealing scattered among selective products.
May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,335 vs bids of 1,332.50 after trading from 1,330 to 1,332.50. May (central) saw offers at 1,310 vs bids 1,305 with earlier trade dones at 1,300 and 1,305.
June (south) was offered at 1,325 vs bids at 1,320 after traded at 1,315 and 1,320.
June (central) saw offers at 1,305 versus bids at 1,297.50.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $557.50, June at $550, July at $545 and Aug/Sept at $540.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, June at $590, July at $577.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $572.50. July was traded at $575.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $422.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $277.50.
